attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, mariadb-server + galera-4), created an application database (appdb.orders) with data, then added node4 as a fourth member via SST — it received the existing data and successfully accepted a write that replicated back to all other members. Completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all four nodes: for each, captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, wsrep_ready=ON, cluster_size, row count), triggered a native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified the node rejoined the cluster (Synced, cluster_size=4) with data intact before restarting the next node. Final check confirmed all four nodes report cluster_size=4 and see a post-restart test write from node2.
